name: 23185 · Williamsburg, VA
findings: ZIP 23185 (Williamsburg) has 208 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23185 (Williamsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
